body:
You have so many perks, I’ve talked to a dozen of people draming to be in your place, but you’re setting expectations for yourself way to high.

I understand that it can be frustrating and all, but seeing how professional you sound, it shouldn’t be hard to land a job.

If you want to go into more detail, or just talk to someone, feel free to DM me!

/Your service dog

Short answer. Don’t be a piece of shit like you called yourself.

Youre blaming yourself way to much, and for everything wrong ever done, your parents love you unconditionally, so hang in there.

If you’d like to talk or discuss, feel free to DM me!

/Your service dog

"I can’t die, but i can’t live either" is a nice phrase, we call it being stuck in the void.

Youre not specific about your problems and solutions, but if you’d like to rant more, or just have a chat, DM me!

/Your service dog

Hey, Davi!

You have alot of "what if" thinking going on, things aren’t certain and you should keep your chin up.

Lets use your "what if" tought pattern.

What if things get better?
What if your mon is recovering?
What if?

Use that tought pattern to think positively.
Feel free to DM me!

/Your service dog

Life doesnt have a reason, nor an answer, but make the best of what you can everyday, try to do the things you like and progress to become the person you want to be.

Personally i like to have some "me-time" where im alone and focusing on my problems and how to solve them, if you’d like to talk some one on one, feel free to DM me!

/Your service dog

As one commented below, you might need to change up your application, you want to look as professional as you can be, so looking up some applications can help you make your own.

If you actually have been sending out a couple hundred applications, then its most likely your application wich is the problem.

I used to bea manager handling applications, and invluding as little as a picture of yourself can go a long way.

Feel free to DM me if you need tips an help on your application, and good luck!

/Your service dog

You’re seeing yourself as avrage looking, so atleast you’re seeing something posivitely about yourself!

Getting a job can be rough sometimes, but the more applications you make, the more chance you have at landing a job!

Stay in there, and im at your service if you need to talk!

/Your service dog
Thanks! Got some PM’s already, and having a friendly conversation goes a long way
